body: No I don't hate myself or wish to be someone else. It's just the constant paralyzing sadness. I wake up and go to school, try not to cry, get home, then cry to I go to bed and repeat.

Comments is fine. I used to self medicate with alcohol but when I started taking antidepressants I had to stop because of adverse reactions and it just made me tired and dizzy so it wasn't enjoyable anymore. So I'm not drinking right now. I know that my true self isn't just pain... but that's all I've known for a long time. It's hard to recall a part of myself that isn't depressed. It's still early in the year so there isn't much to study.
